bibliographic.title: Simple Procedure
bibliographic.author: Polaris Storm
bibliographic.description:
Simple Procedure is a short, dark interactive fiction game where you have to perform surgery to “humanize” animal women. You've done this procedure before, and you will certainly do it again. Today's patient is a mouse-girl.

Content warning: mild sexual references, body horror/gore, surgical themes, and misogyny + slutshaming and fatphobia connected with it. This game is against misogyny and is written by someone AFAB. THIS IS NOT A PORN GAME, the age-gate is due to the mild sexual references and graphic nature of the body horror and gore.

This was created for Neointeractive's 2026 (No) Dialogue Jam! I ended up choosing to go with no dialogue, since I think that fits more thematically. I did have a lot more ambitious ideas for this, but unfortunately, I've been dying from finals so there's no way I would've been able to do more than this short game. This took me about ehhh 5-6 hours total to make? Most of it was done with thanks to a friend who sat on call with me and worked on their own project (thanks if you see this I owe you my life).
